csv_project_name: A/E for Bridge & Hydraulic Steel Structure
csv_agency: US Army Corps of Engineers Huntington District
csv_scope_of_work: Architect-Engineering (A-E) Services through an Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity Contract. Projects may consist of bridge and hydraulic steel structure inspection services located within the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Great Lakes and Ohio River Division (LRD) Mission Boundaries and projects assigned to LRD Districts in support of the USACE mission. The projects include, but are not limited to flood risk management projects, navigation projects, and support for other Federal, State, and Local Agencies.
